design_issues.screen: Finance Console (any tournament, tested on Madhavrao Scindia Trophy)
issues: React hydration console warning: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' inside the bulk-approve-extra-body-select. The <option> for each body currently wraps the count in a <span>, which is invalid HTML. Cosmetic only — the dropdown works — but should be a plain string like `${g.body_id} · Approve ${g.rows.length} Submitted` without the inner <span>.

action_items: (Nit) Remove the inner <span> inside the <option> at TournamentOps.jsx:1335 to silence the React hydration warning for the bulk-approve-extra-body-select dropdown.
critical_code_review_comments: tournament_invoices.create_invoice does not gate on the caller's principal — a Division Secretary can theoretically POST an invoice with body_id != their own body. The bulk-submit / bulk-approve endpoints likewise don't cross-check the caller's scope against payload.body_id. If not enforced upstream (e.g. via UI-only), consider adding a principal check inside these endpoints for SEC parity with other Division/MPCA routes.

extra_expense.bulk_submit_extras / bulk_approve_extras swallow every HTTPException per row and continue silently. If a subset fails (e.g. one is Info_Requested and cannot submit), the caller only sees submitted_count and has no per-row error info — worth returning a `failed:[{id,reason}]` list so the UI can surface partial failures.

TournamentOps.jsx is 1555 lines and now hosts InvoicesTab (~660 lines) + ExtrasTab (~360 lines) in the same module. Consider splitting InvoicesTab and ExtrasTab into their own files under /pages/tournament-ops/.
